items.title: Frank Foster and Bill Hughes interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Schenectady, New York, March 28, 1995
items.q: And Fiddler Williams is a very brilliant violinist.

ctx.x: I don’t think Eddie was playing guitar at that point. If he did it was just occasionally.
Fiddler Williams— And Fiddler Williams is a very brilliant violinist.
Yes he is. He is that.
